regime_context: This detector shows a highly concentrated, one-narrative China A-shares tape: Banks lead with the only high durability bar (0.87) and are the sole strong eligible trend, while Coal is eligible but mean-reverting with low breadth. The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold up historically on this market (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), and the track record's directional accuracy is only 0.337 — so all leans here must be conditional and modest.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Banks–Coal margin (0.071) widens or flips: a confirmed handoff to Coal would require 515220.SS to exceed 512800.SS's score for 5 consecutive sessions AND Coal's durability bar to rise above 0.7 with breadth above 0.5 — until then, treat any Coal strength as a mean-reversion bounce, not rotation.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme with both eligibility and a high durability bar (0.87) under a trend regime, with extremely strong breadth (0.944). This is plausible durable leadership within a narrow rotation, but crowding is extreme (z=1.98) and the gate has no drawdown edge on this market, so the lean is a continuation-of-tape provisional view, not a forecast.
evidence: one_narrative=true, narrow rotation (eligible frac 0.09) means leadership is concentrated
crowding_z=1.98 → size-down caution only, not a fade
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding (one_narrative, z=1.98) plus the failure of the trend gate to cut drawdown historically on this mean-reverting tape means a sharp shake-out in Banks is plausible and the detector has no edge to call the timing.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by over 5% before the 30-day check-by date or its durability bar drops below 0.6.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal ranks second and is technically eligible, but its durability bar is only 0.47 and its hurst_tag is mean-revert with breadth of just 0.2 — a thin, low-durability bounce rather than a durable trend. The rotation margin over Coal is modest (0.071) so this is not a confirmed handoff.
evidence: crowding_z=0.5, not crowded, but not a trend-health setup
theses.dissent: If mean-reversion favors a bounce in an oversold commodity theme and Banks correct, Coal's second-ranked momentum could briefly lead; avoiding it surrenders that short-term pop.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS closes above its 20-day high with breadth above 0.5 and the durability bar rises above 0.7 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
